WITH circuit_averages AS (
  SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS average_round
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_baselines AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(average_round) AS baseline
  FROM circuit_averages
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.average_round,
       ca.average_round - cb.baseline AS difference_from_country_baseline
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_baselines AS cb ON ca.country = cb.country
ORDER BY difference_from_country_baseline DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
